patches.description: Build the product-teaser Details link with the canonical getProductLink(urlKey, sku) instead of hand-building it with rootLink — so this demo-team custom block (demo-system-stores/accs-citisignal) produces the same Helix-clean /products/{urlKey}/{sku} path as every Adobe canonical product block. A hand-built link keeps the SKU's case and underscores, which Helix strips when it publishes, so the link would miss the page.
patches.exit: TODO: file PR to demo-system-stores/accs-citisignal so the block calls getProductLink; delete on merge.

patches.description: Redirect a published PDP whose SKU no longer resolves to the native 404 instead of mounting an empty drop-in. The warm path: a previously-published PDP serves 200 from the content bus, so the CDN-404 smart-404 snippet never runs; fetchProductData resolves null for an unknown SKU and the initializer mounted anyway.
